content:
I can read and understand information in many languages. My ability to "read" really means I can process and generate text in those languages. I've been trained on a massive dataset that includes text from a wide variety of human languages, so if you ask me in a language I've encountered, I can likely understand and respond to you in that language.

I don't have a "native language" in the way humans do, but I'm constantly learning and improving my understanding of different linguistic nuances.
